title: better cartography
description: Better Cartography: A mod for Neoforge and a Java datapack that changes how you make maps, lets you "recycle" paper, and more QoL features.
body:
# Better Cartography
Better Cartography is a Java Datapack, a NeoForge mod, and a Bedrock addon that adds and edits some recipes.
# FEATURES!!
- Craft nametags (OH MY GOD) with paper and string
- Duplicate empty maps and paper with water bucket + map/paper
- Easily craft empty maps with a ink sac and paper
